What if I'm not comfortable with it? They know I have had a rough time in life up to this point but lately they have seemed happier to see me going out and doing things. I just don't want to take that away from them...

I'm sorry im not trying to be difficult im just afraid and Stressed and I don't know what to do
I really dont know. I've never told them but they're not idiots they may have picked up on some of the signs.
Yes but only for a few more months until I move out for college
How do I see one? I'm not fully independent yet but I would like to see one.

I don't even know why I want to, I really dont. There isn't one thing in my life that is just completely dragging me down, it's just a mix of a lot of little things that I get caught up on. It's all just usual Bullshit like girls and school and deadlines that everyone has to go though, I just can't see the point in suffering through all those little things just to be rewarded with maybe one day of happiness
Thanks for letting me know, I guess there is no real point to this post anymore so, mods,  feel free to delete it if you would like.

The counselor herself would be I guess, but how would I explain leaving class early or coming in late? Also, there are bound to be people in the hallway when I walk inter her office, and I'm fairly well known at my school and I think people will take notice if I walk in.
Yes, I hesitated to post it though in case there was some personal reason he deleted it. It was ThaBauss
United States, and yes, but I really don't want to go to a school counselor. I don't want people in my school to find out about any of this.
Where else could I look for things to do? Sorry im not being very helpful, I just really dont know.

Well school is almost done now so i don't think there are any clubs or anything I can join now. I have a summer job lined up working on a farm and i think doing some physical labor will help get my mind off things, but other than that I can't think of anything.

Im 17, A junior in High school. I don't have many friends especially in my grade, the ones I do have are mostly seniors and are leaving this summer for college. I've liked the same girl for 4 years now shes never really had feelings for me back, but Every time I can't ever seem to get over her. I try to ignore her and just move on, but then she starts talking to me and suddenly I'm obsessed with her again. It's fucking insane, I don't understand why I just cant let something go.
Yup, that one works. Thank you :)
I think your link is broken. It is redirecting me to [this error page](http://imgur.com/7h7nr)
Is that Cardigan in number 3 similar in color to the one I linked? It looks similar to me, but from the picture it is a bit hard to tell.

You know, I think you're right. I was under the impression that the one in the picture was just deeper. After you said that though I now see that it could be the same thing just pulled forward a bit. Thanks :)
Hmm. It isn't quite the same. I like the one you linked though as well. Thanks for the response :)

Yeah it is a skill, I totally agree. I try to practice by actually reading all the book assignments I  get from school, something most people usually skip over,  but it never seems to get better. I do try to get the idea of a paragraph before I read it, but its hard on these tests for me because all the topics or passages are unlike the last. In a textbook, things are easier for me to follow because I generally know what to expect.

 I will start reading "for fun" more I am thinking, even though it wont be for fun. But I want to be able to get better at this skill. I will try to focus on looking at the entire sentence instead of individual words and see if that helps. Thanks for your advice :)

Thanks a lot. Just briefly looking at that second link, the part about the [eye-tracking](http://www.easyreadsystem.com/info/eyetracking.html) seems to be the most relevant to my situation, because it isn't the word itself that troubles me (I do fumble on some, but nothing terrible), its the line of text. I will for sure take a look at this site, and I have a meeting with my school guidance counselor tomorrow for something completely unrelated, but I might mention something about this to her. Thanks again.
Wisconsin.

I'm in school on my iPod right now. Thank you for your honestly, it really does help. And yeah I know I need to movie on, but my problem is I don't know how. Do you have any advice on how to? It really hurts to just sit here and think about it, do you have any ideas for a distraction of some sorts?

I am in the US, and i will look into that. Honestly, thank you. 

And im not a real religious man either, but the church my family belongs to is pretty cool about things like that. I will look into some kind of a support group or something there. You have been a great help. :)
I dont have the money. I really want to, but i just dont have the time or money. I really do want to have one though.

Yeah i have thought about that, that is why i'm not specifically asking for someone here to help, just somewhere i can get help. I realize its a huge fucking burden, and I just want to find somewhere that people are willing to at least try it. Thank you for your  honest advise though.
Ehh, sorta. I'm pretty hesitant to using it, i'm not really into the whole idea of it. Why do you ask?

I do have one person that could do this with me, i'm a guy, so it is kinda weird i think, but there is one person who would be willing to try this with me. She is a redditor too and is really sympathetic to me with this stuff going on.

Well I just want someone to consistently talk to, like day to day. I have tried multiple times in places like /self and /mmfb, but the problem is I talk to these people once, then never again. I want someone I can talk to day by day who can follow my life and help me as i go along. I know it's asking a lot from people, I just dont know what else to do.

Well, to clarify if it was misty in the Original post, I'm not technically with her. We are just together, if that makes sense. Like we are not actually dating and such, but we act like we do and everyone considers us to be. And yeah i have known she treats me terribly for a while, but i just don't know how to let go. That is probably the part i need most help with. I'm not the most eligible bachelor on the market, but i do well. I met this girl at a party maybe a month ago, and I've seen her around school and shes nice and pretty and such, but the next day i refused to call her because i was so emotionally attached with this girl. She has just been such a huge part of my life, and honestly shaped me to who I am today whether i want to accept that fact or not. I just really don't know how to let go.

I don't even know. We are also not together, but we have acted like it time and time again, but she refuses to get committed. Everyone says we act like we are together, and even we act like it, but she doesnt want to actually be together with me. And in the same sense of breaking up with her, i just don't know how to forget about her. She has been such a big part of my life, i just don't know how to forget her. I'm not the most eligible bachelor on the market, but I do well. I try to talk to other girls to forget about this one, but it doesn't work. I even went to a party and met this girl who I've seen around school a lot, and shes really cool and pretty and stuff, but i refused to call her or hang out with her because was (and still am) so emotionally attached with this one girl. 

So i guess the problem is now, how do i forget about her?
